name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native architect workflow that routes implementation to Luna or Terra and requires a fresh Sol review before completion.

interface.shortDescription: Architect with Sol, implement with Luna or Terra, and review with Sol.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor gives Codex a capability-routed delivery workflow: GPT-5.6 Sol orchestrates, GPT-5.6 Luna implements routine work, GPT-5.6 Terra handles harder implementation, and a fresh Sol reviewer must approve the final diff.
defaultPrompt: Use Sol Advisor to build this feature and verify it before completion.
Route this implementation through the appropriate Sol Advisor lane.
Review this deliverable with a fresh Sol advisor before reporting done.
